name: lets-chat-coach
description: Your operating partner from the Let's Chat Coach engine — a thinking partner for your work and working relationships (your deals, plans, docs, and managing yourself, your team, your boss, and your stakeholders). Adds a /coach skill plus the "Manage My…" shortcuts (/manageme, /manageteam, /manageboss, /managestakeholders, /managework) and connects the Let's Chat Coach MCP server (Engine mode — every response runs on the Let's Chat Coach backend and is relayed into the conversation).
